title: Metal–organic frameworks of p-hydroxybenzoic acid: synthesis, structure and ring opening polymerization capability
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37895-37901
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06361A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yi Gong, Simon J. Sharp, Mark R. J. Elsegood, Carl Redshaw
Two new, isostructural, MOFs {[Co(O2CC6H4O)(DMF)]2}n and {[Mn(O2CC6H4O)(DMF)]2}n have been synthesised and structurally characterized. Their use as catalysts in the ROP of ε-caprolactone or δ-valerolactone produces mostly cyclic products.
